data.content_ref: inline:Integration: SRC_005's fragility profile must integrate with SRC_014's two-pass semantics, so fragility is measured on the outer graph while deletions in the inner warrant graph can flip which attacks survive. Refuted if deleting an inner-graph edge changes the outer labelling while no outer edge is deleted, so the outer-only fragility profile reports a node stable when the warrant filter has silently altered its defense.
